summary: Iter56 Trip Log Search/Filter/Pagination — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. Backend: 16/16 iter56 pytest PASS; Deploy Guard status=pass, exit_code=0, elapsed=215.1s (re-triggered via /api/admin/deploy-readiness/run-now — the initial cached state had a stale SIGTERM=-15 from a prior backend restart). Frontend: All 15 required testids render on /trips (trips-filter-bar + inputs + presets + pagination + clear + trip-count-total). Free-text 'Kondapalli' narrows 9032→27; trips-search-clear (X) restores to 9032. Date-range 2026-08-01..10 → 42 trips. Presets 7/30/90d auto-fill date fields correctly (7d→27, 30d→39, 90d→714). Clear Filters shows '(N)' badge and resets all. AND semantics verified: date-only=42 → date+q=28 (strict subset). Pagination 'Page 1 of 91', prev disabled at page1; next → page 2, prev enabled, first row differs across pages; filters persist across pagination. Row-click navigates to /trips/{id}/view. Action button (delete) does NOT trigger row nav (event.stopPropagation OK). Multi-company isolation verified: switching from 'TEST Iter7 Co · default' (9032 trips) to 'BKA Logistics 17' shows empty state — no cross-tenant leakage. Iter55 TripForm regression not re-exercised (backend regression suite covers it and Iter50 already validated).

minor.issue: Cached deploy_status can persist a SIGTERM (-15) failure across backend restarts if the subprocess was killed after >60s elapsed (guard only skips rc=-15 with elapsed<60). Recovered by POST /api/admin/deploy-readiness/run-now. Consider extending the skip window or clearing stale status on startup.

ui_bugs.issue: Could not locate a [data-testid="deploy-guard-status"] (or similar) on /dashboard. Regression request explicitly checks 'Deploy Guard tile still shows PASS' — testid appears missing (backend confirms PASS via API).
Dropdown lists ~45 companies including many duplicates ('BKA Logistics 17' × 15+) — data hygiene issue from prior iter test seeding, not iter56. No testid on the <select>.

Popover search input inside the trips-filter-customer/vehicle/supplier dropdowns has no data-testid, making Playwright automation of type-to-search harder. Visually confirmed working (screenshot shows customer popover with search input + option list including TEST_Iter42 etc).

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="deploy-guard-status" to the dashboard Deploy Guard tile to make regression assertions robust.
(Optional) Add data-testid on the search input inside each searchable dropdown popover (customer/vehicle/supplier) for E2E automation.

critical_code_review_comments: Trips.jsx filter bar uses server-side pagination + debounced q correctly and preserves latest-first sort — no client-side mutation of trip records observed.
Delete/Edit/View/LR/Share/Eway/Duplicate action buttons appear to correctly use stopPropagation — verified click on delete-trip-{id} does not navigate to /view.
list_trips endpoint returns X-Total-Count + X-Has-More headers and honours company scoping (multi-company isolation test PASS).
Consider a getBoundingClientRect check on the very wide company <select> — 45 options with duplicates is a UX smell but not a functional bug.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 iter56 + Deploy Guard PASS after run-now)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all primary filter/pagination/AND/row-click/multi-company flows PASS; only deploy-guard tile testid not found)

seed_data_creation: iter56 pytest fixture creates 3 known trips (Kondapalli×2 + Vizag×1) with own+supplier vehicles and a dedicated CUST_IT56_* customer — used for filter assertions. No manual UI seeding added by this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary iter56 flows validated. Deploy Guard tile testid on dashboard should be added by main agent if regression assertions require it. If retesting: use POST /api/admin/deploy-readiness/run-now before checking status (initial cached SIGTERM may be stale). Baseline default-company trip count in demo tenant is ~9,032; the default active company is 'TEST Iter7 Co · default' (co_c2ac839cf8bf4ff4). Switching to 'BKA Logistics 17' (co_09e2044551cb4a69) gives empty trip list — good multi-tenant isolation smoke test.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in iter56. The only backend anomaly (cached SIGTERM deploy status) is a known behaviour of the background regression watcher when the subprocess is killed after 60s (see server.py:216 — skip only when elapsed<60). Root cause: prior backend restart during a long regression run. Mitigation: manual POST /api/admin/deploy-readiness/run-now cleared it (rc=0, 215.1s).
